title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-07
lineage: SBD > MR > Cass > DAT > ZA2 > SoundForge > CD Architect > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with a warm acoustic set and a stellar Cryptical > Drums > Other One sequence, despite some bass‑heavy tape warble.
ai_review.review: The June 7 1970 Fillmore West show captures an intimate three‑set performance that shines on the acoustic opener and the second‑set Cryptical Envelopment → Drums → The Other One → Cryptical Reprise stretch. Jerry’s voice soars on New Speedway Boogie while his guitar work dazzles on Casey Jones, and the Good Lovin’ drum jam is a highlight. The SBD source is generally clear but exhibits heavy bass, occasional hiss and a splice glitch in Cumberland Blues.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers (20+) give 4‑5 stars and praise the performance; recording issues are noted but do not dominate, yielding a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm SBD capture with noticeable bass boost, occasional tape warble/hiss and a splice glitch in Cumberland Blues; unmiked crowd voice during drums adds character but overall fidelity is solid.

standout_songs: Cryptical Envelopment > Drums > The Other One > Cryptical Reprise
Good Lovin' > Drums > Good Lovin' jam
poor_songs: Silver Threads and Golden Needles (ragged performance)
Sugar Magnolia (slow tempo, deemed weakest by some reviewers)
show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert opens with a breezy acoustic set that sets a relaxed vibe, followed by a powerful second set highlighted by the Cryptical‑drums‑Other One suite and expansive jams. The third set continues the momentum with tight rockers and classic finishes, delivering a well‑balanced three‑set arc.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals shine on New Speedway Boogie (though a few reviewers note slight strain); guitar work praised especially on Casey Jones; also appears on pedal steel during the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Generally solid bass foundation, but his vocal harmonies are described as off on Silver Threads and Golden Needles.
band_member_comments.Bob: Provides strong harmony on Me & My Uncle and adds humorous stage banter about audience song requests.
band_member_comments.Drums: Strong, especially in the quiet transition between Cryptical and The Other One; Good Lovin' drum jam highlighted; occasional unmiked woman voice heard during drums.
